body:
Inventory warnings, validation messages and transfer difference statuses use shared Clean Look tokens. Transfer differences retain Open/Resolved words and use the standard status dot. The original eleven-file scope contains eight Vue files, the owner-approved STK6 token assertion update, token tests and a TEAM record. No inventory feature, migration, permission or mutation behavior changes.

The normal current-main refresh preserves all eleven originally reviewed file blobs byte-for-byte. Independent reviews verified exact scope and hashes, current-main ancestry and all eight scripts matching main after excluding only the StatusBadge import. The original approved assertion is unchanged; no additional test adaptations are introduced.

Refreshed validation: all 2,207 frontend tests pass with zero failures/skips, full TypeScript and production build pass, and scoped lint/format/diff checks pass. This clean full-suite run follows normal Wayfinder generation and supersedes the earlier publication's generated-route setup limitation without editing assertions. Prior exact-source 28 responsive checks and synthetic transfer flows remain carried historical evidence; no fresh current-main browser matrix or full backend rerun is claimed for this presentation-only refresh. Exact-head CI and then-current-main containment remain merge gates. This is a foundation restyle, not complete Inventory demo parity.
